settings.title: Settings ⚙️
settings.makeItYours: Make it yours — we won't judge! 😄

subscription.upgradeSubtitle: Unlock the AI advisor, receipt scan and bank sync
subscription.proSubtitle: AI advisor, receipt scan, email detection and bank sync
subscription.restoredBody: Any active subscription on this account has been reapplied.
subscription.nothingToRestoreBody: We couldn't find an active subscription for this account. If you subscribed with a different Apple ID or Google account, sign in with that one and try again.
subscription.bankProTitle: Bank sync is a Pro feature
subscription.bankProBody: Upgrade to Pro in Settings to connect your bank. You can always import a statement instead — that works on any plan.
subscription.aiLimitReached: You've used your free AI requests for today. Upgrade to Pro in Settings for more.
subscription.pdfProBody: Reading PDF statements uses AI. Upgrade to Pro in Settings, or import a CSV instead — CSV is parsed on your device and is always more accurate.

deleteAccount.entryHint: Permanently erase your account and all data
deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.intro: This permanently deletes your account and everything in it. It cannot be undone, and we cannot recover it for you afterwards.
deleteAccount.plusRest: Plus your settings, budgets, bill reminders, recurring transactions and achievements.
deleteAccount.businessWarningBody: You own this business, so deleting your account removes it entirely — including %{expenses} and access for %{members}. Their records go too.
deleteAccount.revokeNote: We'll revoke access to your linked bank and inbox connections first, so they stop sharing data with us.
deleteAccount.loadFailed: Could not load your account details. Check your connection and try again.
deleteAccount.deleteFailed: Your account could not be deleted. Please try again.
deleteAccount.deletedBody: Your account and data are gone. We couldn't automatically revoke everything though — please disconnect these yourself:

import.bankSubtitle: CIH, Attijariwafa, or any bank — export a CSV
import.csvBody: Processed entirely on your device. If we can't recognise the columns, you'll be asked to point them out — no file is ever a dead end.
import.pdfBody: For banks that only offer PDF. Read by AI on our server, so it leaves your device — we ask first. CSV is always more accurate where your bank offers it.
import.analysingHint: A full page of transactions can take up to a minute.
import.mappingTitle: We couldn't read this file's columns
import.mappingBody: Tell us which column holds what and we'll take it from there. Your bank's wording is shown with a sample value from the file.
import.pickColumns: Pick a date and an amount column
import.formatRememberedHint: Reusing the settings from your last import from this bank. Change them if anything looks wrong.
import.formatGuessedHint: We had to guess part of this. Check the dates and amounts below look right.
import.formatDetectedHint: Detected from your file. Change these if anything looks wrong.

advisor.issue: I'm sorry, I encountered an issue: %{message}
advisor.upgraded: You're all set — ask me anything.

bank.findYourBankHint: Search thousands of banks in your country
bank.consentSubtitle: You'll choose your bank and sign in on their secure page.
bank.unavailableBody: Bank linking is not configured on the server yet. Please try again later.
